visual_thesis: A triumphant football stadium visual language featuring Galatasaray signature crimson red and gold lion motifs, glossy metallic badges, leather soccer balls, and stadium turf aesthetics.
art_style: Glossy casual-mobile 3D render with polished crimson and vibrant gold lighting, crisp bevels, and vivid high-contrast silhouettes.
